{{Quote|Look out, stripling! The cur's pulling a ''micro-jolt'' from his tunic!|[[Elglih]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SW64" />}}
A '''micro-jolt''' was a small handheld weapon. When the [[Serp]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[S'Shah]] lost a bout against the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] during the [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Joust]] tourney of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]], the monarch attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker with a micro-jolt he had hidden on his person. However, Skywalker blasted the King with an [[Energy lance/Legends|energy lance]], killing him.
